history.scope: Common labelled actions with non-clearing final frames in both runs; repeated boundaries and pages without foreground chapter jobs; diagnostic USB host-to-driver elapsed time.
limitations: The page-index-matched subset additionally requires equal and stable reported total-page values before and after each action. It does not prove equal active background work or cache contents. count=counting is a status label, not proof of an active pagination worker.

Old pagination-v4 caches were invalidated by v5. Natural preparation does not guarantee complete indexing under memory admission limits; completed-index versus unknown-index actions remain only in the broader table.
Current persistent caches are retained; first open and cold boundary timings are not comparable.
Current workload starts each group with K2 and repositions using K1; automatic full-clean cadence differs and mismatched full frames are excluded.
Book bytes are rechecked separately; semantic positions use source anchors; CRC includes changing footer counters and battery/time.
Sequential historical runs, not randomized A/B; small-sample P99 is often the maximum.

host.lsan: unsupported by this macOS runtime; not completed
host.website: installer regressions and 5-page build passed; not deployed

issues.finding: The ClearCache input path synchronously waits for producers, recursively deletes cached files and redraws storage statistics; no intermediate feedback frame is shown.
issues.reason: A complete fix needs background file ownership and sleep/USB cancellation coordination; adding only a prompt would leave the input blockage.
issues.timing_limit: The 22.323 second interval covers the whole input callback; producer shutdown, deletion and storage statistics were not timed separately.

issues.finding: Long-chapter reopen at the saved position after clearing derived caches took 5289.024 ms.
issues.measurement_scope: accepted diagnostic command to completed content and confirmed frame

issues.finding: After cache clear, first apple result took 19.800 s; the first adjusted miss scanned and prepared the remaining sources and took 40.561 s.
issues.scope: Single cold samples with 9 enabled sources, including one known broken source; waiting UI remained responsive.

limitations: Physical touch, panel ghosting/near-monochrome optical comparison and electrical input were not tested.
Current/energy, long sleep/wake, actual power loss/card removal/slow card and real low-memory hardware injection were not tested.
No USB-MSC handoff, OTA slot switch or real KOReader client round trip; existing factory layout has no OTA slots.
No rerun of the prior 400-page UTF-16 cross-part device workload.
Historical timing is sequential, with different cache/index state and without a new TF model inventory; it does not establish a controlled regression.
Dictionary hot results are one repeated English word; other language/query distributions, cold validation repetitions, handle counts and whole-path instantaneous peak memory remain unmeasured.
Source C041, inline SVG and long KOReader source-node limitations remain.
